cancelUpkeep(uint256).details: if a user cancels an upkeep, their funds are locked for CANCELLATION_DELAY blocks to allow any pending performUpkeep txs time to get confirmed

constructor.details: we cast the contract to logicC in order to call logicC functions (via fallback)

params.logicB: the address of the second logic contract

migrateUpkeeps(uint256[],address).details: a transcoder must be set in order to enable migrationmigration permissions must be set on *both* sending and receiving registriesonly an upkeep admin can migrate their upkeepsthis function is most gas-efficient if upkeepIDs are sorted by billing tokens_billingOverrides and s_upkeepPrivilegeConfig are not migrated in this function

onTokenTransfer(address,uint256,bytes).details: safe to cast uint256 to uint96 as total LINK supply is under UINT96MAX

params.sender: the account which transferred the funds

receiveUpkeeps(bytes).details: this function is never called directly, it is only called by another registry's migrate functions_billingOverrides and s_upkeepPrivilegeConfig are not handled in this function

params.encodedUpkeeps: the raw upkeep data to import

params.admin: address to cancel upkeep and withdraw remaining funds
params.billingToken: the billing token for the upkeep
params.checkData: data passed to the contract when checking for upkeep
params.gasLimit: amount of gas to provide the target contract when performing upkeep
params.offchainConfig: arbitrary offchain config for the upkeep

acceptOwnership().notice: Allows an ownership transfer to be completed by the recipient.

fallbackTo().notice: returns the address of the next contract in the chain

migrateUpkeeps(uint256[],address).notice: migrates upkeeps from one registry to another.

onTokenTransfer(address,uint256,bytes).notice: uses LINK's transferAndCall to LINK and add funding to an upkeep

receiveUpkeeps(bytes).notice: received upkeeps migrated from another registry

transferOwnership(address).notice: Allows an owner to begin transferring ownership to a new address.
